summary_en: 300,000 shares (1.96% of shares outstanding) to be acquired via ToSTNeT-3 on 2026-07-21 at opening of session. Upper limit ¥1,356M. Execution window 08:45 JST, single-session order. Settlement post-trade.
title_en: Notice regarding acquisition of treasury shares via off-exchange purchase transaction (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: SRA Holdings resolved on 2026-07-21 to execute a discrete block acquisition of treasury shares via ToSTNeT-3. The block consists of 300,000 shares (1.96% of shares outstanding, calculated as 300,000 ÷ 15,306,838) with an upper limit of ¥1,356M. Execution is scheduled for 2026-07-21 at 08:45 JST in a single-session order at the day's closing reference price of ¥4,520/share. Results will be announced immediately after trading concludes. This block is part of a broader ¥4.3B, 960,000-share authorization (6.29% of S/O) approved by the board on the same date, which permits acquisition through ToSTNeT-3 and open-market purchases over the period 2026-07-21 to 2027-03-31.
